name: smart-compact
description: Lets Claude compact its own context with your approval, and adds its keep rules to every compaction.

grantCheck.title: Grant check
grantCheck.description: judge: before each compaction under a grant, the session model judges from the conversation whether the grant still covers the current work. trust: an active grant always applies.

grantMaxTurns.title: Grant lifetime (turns)
grantMaxTurns.description: Turns after which a grant lapses whatever the judge says; 0 for no limit.

briefReminderCalls.title: Brief reminder (tool calls)
briefReminderCalls.description: While a grant is active or a brief is saved, remind Claude every this many tool calls to bring its task brief up to date; 0 to turn off.
